name: Temple of Atal'Hakkar
summary: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar lies drowned beneath the Swamp of Sorrows, its halls still touched by corruption. Exiled troll priests raised it for Hakkar, and Ysera's green dragons sank it beneath the marsh centuries ago.

sections.title: Wrath of the Green Flight
sections.body: More than a thousand years ago, civil war broke the Gurubashi Empire after the Atal'ai priesthood tried to summon Hakkar the Soulflayer. Exiled north, the surviving priests built a great stone temple in the Swamp of Sorrows to finish their work. Ysera, the Dragon Aspect, learned of their scheme and drove the temple deep into the mire. Its halls flooded beneath the Pool of Tears, while green dragon wardens remained to guard the ruins and keep Hakkar from returning.

sections.title: A Slumber Turned Nightmare
sections.body: The flooded halls gave the Atal'ai the seclusion to continue their sacrifices. Over the centuries, corruption took hold of the guardians. The green dragon sentinels fell into madness, while the Atal'ai, led by Jammal'an the Prophet, prepare the way for Hakkar's avatar. The Horde and Alliance watch the sunken temple uneasily as rumors rise from the swamp's depths.

faq.answer: Ysera, Aspect of the green dragonflight, sank the temple beneath the marsh waters to stop the Atal'ai trolls from summoning the blood god Hakkar into Azeroth.
The Atal'ai are fanatical troll priests exiled from the southern Gurubashi Empire for practicing blood magic and trying to bring Hakkar the Soulflayer into the physical realm.

faq.q: Why are there green dragons here?
faq.answer: Ysera sent green dragons as guardians to watch the sunken ruins, keep trespassers out, and prevent Hakkar's summoning. Many have fallen to madness and dark corruption.

faq.q: How do you get inside the temple?
faq.answer: Swim into the flooded ruins from the Pool of Tears and pass through the submerged ways of the Broken Hall. Then climb the stone corridors, including the Hall of Masks.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you see these ruins as a grim reminder of the blood-soaked madness that ruined the ancient Gurubashi Empire and the lasting danger of Hakkar the Soulflayer.
As a druid, you know corruption among Ysera's green dragon wardens strikes at the heart of the Emerald Dream. The depths demand swift investigation.
